title: satk.util.adsr~
description: `satk.util.adsr~` is a multi-segment ADSR ramp generator for shaping values or audio amplitude with configurable attack, decay, sustain, and release stages. A gate value greater than 0 starts the attack and holds the envelope at the sustain level after decay, while 0 triggers the release; it provides both data-rate and signal-rate output.
